title: gynura pseudochina var. hispida
intro: Gynura pseudochina var. hispida, commonly known as Bunga Raya or Purple Stem Candra, is a type of plant native to Southeast Asia and a member of the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Gynura pseudochina var. hispida include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its ability to modulate the body's immune response and alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which have been isolated and identified through various studies.
